CustomField.label: Duplicate Of Lead
CustomField.description: LEGACY as of 2026-07-31 — no longer written by any code path (competing brokers no longer receive a Lead). Retained for historical data only. Formerly pointed to the winning Lead - the first broker to submit this property. Populated only when Is_Duplicate_Property__c is true.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: LEGACY — was the original Lead that claimed this property first; no longer written as of 2026-07-31.
